name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
measures: Composite score over several evaluations run by Artificial Analysis; the leaderboard also gives cost per task.
caveats: Composite: hides which kind of task a model is good at. Scores are per effort setting.

name: Terminal-Bench
measures: Agent work in a terminal: multi-step tasks graded by tests.
caveats: Each row pairs a model with an agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI...): it measures the pair, not the model alone. The board does not show who submitted each row.

name: Remote Labor Index
measures: Share of 240 real freelance projects where a client would accept the AI deliverable as at least as good as the human one (automation rate).
caveats: Rows carry no dates; the newest models may be missing.

name: SWE-bench Pro (public set)
caveats: At the last check the official board listed no model released after early 2026. Do not copy vendor-reported scores as if they were board results.

name: SWE-rebench
measures: Fresh repository tasks filtered by date, to limit contamination.
caveats: Task window 2026-05-15 to 2026-07-01 at the last check: no model released after June 2026 is listed yet.

name: Arena text leaderboard
measures: Human preference votes between anonymous answers (Elo-style score).
caveats: Measures preference, not correctness. Model names were not machine-readable at the last check: record scores only when the model is identified unambiguously.

name: SWE-bench Verified
measures: Resolving real GitHub issues (500 human-verified tasks).
caveats: Saturated and contaminated: archived by Vals AI and dropped by OpenAI in 2026. Do not record new scores.

name: Aider polyglot
caveats: Not updated since November 2025. Do not record new scores.
